_comment: Nightly Business Central -> GL Account sync. A MJ: Scheduled Jobs record run by the scheduling-engine's IntegrationSyncScheduledJobDriver, which reads Configuration.CompanyIntegrationID and calls IntegrationEngine.RunSync. Authored INERT (Status=Paused); flip to Active at wiring time (see ../erp-account-sync/README.md). Engine computes NextRunAt from CronExpression on first poll (OwnerUserID/NextRunAt intentionally omitted — both nullable).

fields.Name: BizApps Accounting - Nightly Business Central GL Account Sync
fields.Description: Pulls the Business Central chart of accounts into GL Accounts nightly at 02:00 UTC. Paused until the BizApps Accounting - Business Central GL Account Sync company integration is wired (company + credentials) and activated.
